text:
Maya: FYI I opened a PR to reorganize the Reserved Capacity section. Main goals: move runnable examples into /examples, tighten autoscale wording, and fix a stale migration link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4198
Rohan: nice. can you call out exactly where the migration link 404s? I can update redirects if needed.
Maya: the old terraform migration link in the 'migrating from self-host' subsection points to /legacy/terraform which no longer exists. proposing we point it to /cli/migrate and add a short note about terragrunt variants.
Nina: small request on autoscale wording: users asked for a clear line about "burst capacity" guarantees. suggest a short table: guarantee/no-guarantee/notes. keeps the handbook scannable.
Carlos: +1 for the table. also add a tiny python SDK example for reserving capacity programmatically. those examples get copied into customer repos all the time. here's a draft: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(token=REDACTED)
client.reservations.create(name=\"team-b-res\", gpus=4, isolation=\"tenant\")
```
Maya: great — I'll move Terraform + SDK snippets to examples/reservations.md and reference them. keeping the handbook narrative only.
Rohan: wording nit: avoid mixing "reserved" and "dedicated" in the same paragraph unless you define them. people conflate them. also explicitly describe fallback order when reserved pool is exhausted.
Nina: about eviction semantics: can we add a one-line pointer to the runtime eviction matrix? customers want to know if tenant-isolated pools can still be preempted under host pressure.
Carlos: infra answered on the infra ticket: tenant isolation biases allocation but does not provide absolute anti-eviction guarantees. I'll paste a short sentence and link.
Jen: I found the broken link in the migration guide too. can confirm new target /cli/migrate has the terraform conversion snippet. i'll add a redirect in the site config after the PR merges.
doc-bot: tasks generated - move code samples to /examples, add autoscale guarantee table, update migration link, add eviction-matrix reference, separate SDK sample file, add console SLO link.
Maya: thanks all. I'll split the files, push changes tonight, and request reviews from Carlos + Rohan. pinging once merged for backport to release-1.3.
Rohan: leaving one inline comment re: phrasing in the SLA paragraph — suggest "no SLA for burst capacity" rather than "best effort". clearer for contracts.
Nina: LGTM on the example split. small doc-style note: prefer active voice in troubleshooting steps.
Carlos: reviewed the SDK snippet file locally; added a note about client retries and idempotency token.
Jen: after approvals I'll handle the redirect and the backport.
Maya: closing this thread when PR lands. thanks everyone :party_popper:
